sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "photo_url" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_login_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_hex" TEXT NOT NULL, "repository_url" TEXT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence" REAL NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "pattern" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "data_sources" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_label" TEXT NULL, "host" TEXT NULL, "granted_scopes" TEXT NULL, "sync_cursor" TEXT NULL, "last_synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "connected_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "paired_devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES data_sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "public_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "paired_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_seen_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tracked_repositories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES data_sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "ignored" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("ignored" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "work_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activity_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES data_sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "external_id" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "application" TEXT NULL, "workspace_path" TEXT NULL, "domain" TEXT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES work_sessions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "project_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "attribution" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "confidence" REAL NULL, "attribution_reason" TEXT NULL, "merged_event_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "is_private" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_private" IN (0, 1)), "is_corrected" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_corrected" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_tombstones" ("source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES data_sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "external_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source_id", "external_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exclusions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reports" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "period" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "generated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_provider_subject_idx ON users (provider, subject_id)
CREATE INDEX project_rules_project_idx ON project_rules (project_id)
CREATE INDEX data_sources_kind_idx ON data_sources (kind)
CREATE INDEX paired_devices_source_idx ON paired_devices (source_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tracked_repositories_source_name_idx ON tracked_repositories (source_id, full_name)
CREATE INDEX tracked_repositories_project_idx ON tracked_repositories (project_id)
CREATE INDEX work_sessions_started_idx ON work_sessions (started_at)
CREATE INDEX work_sessions_project_idx ON work_sessions (project_id)
CREATE INDEX activity_events_started_idx ON activity_events (started_at)
CREATE INDEX activity_events_project_idx ON activity_events (project_id)
CREATE INDEX activity_events_session_idx ON activity_events (session_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX activity_events_source_external_idx ON activity_events (source_id, external_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX exclusions_kind_value_idx ON exclusions (kind, value)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reports_period_start_idx ON reports (period, period_start)
